name: Title Partner
summary: Our lead partner. Your name sits alongside ours for the whole season, on the car and everywhere the car appears.

benefits.livery: Largest placement — nose, both sidepods and rear wing
benefits.kit: Front of race suits, team kit and pit apparel
benefits.website: Full-size logo on the home page, /sponsors and every page footer
benefits.social: 6 dedicated features, plus named in every competition post
benefits.launchEvent: Named partner, speaking slot and branded backdrop
benefits.cvBook: Full access, two weeks before any other partner
benefits.factoryVisit: Two workshop visits per season, plus design review attendance

name: Gold Partner
summary: Prominent placement on the car and strong recruitment access, without the exclusivity of title.

benefits.livery: Large placement on the sidepods or rear wing
benefits.kit: Sleeve or back of team kit
benefits.website: Full-size logo on the home page and /sponsors

name: Silver Partner
summary: A visible place on the car and on this site, for organisations backing us at a departmental level.

benefits.website: Medium logo on /sponsors and the site footer

name: Bronze Partner
summary: Entry-level support. The tier most of our first-year partners start at, and most of them move up.

benefits.livery: Logo on the rear wing endplate
benefits.website: Logo on /sponsors and the site footer

name: In-Kind Partner
summary: Parts, materials, machining, software or logistics instead of cash. Valued at market rate and placed at the equivalent tier.

benefits.livery: Placed at the tier your contribution is valued at
benefits.kit: Placed at the tier your contribution is valued at
benefits.website: Logo on /sponsors, listed with what you supply
benefits.social: 1 feature per season, plus credit whenever we use the part
